_help: UHV SEM control card (vacuum system). The card address and enabling control are set per PC in config/local.json as card_address / card_control_enabled (Vacuum -> Advanced in the app). Test mode always uses a simulated card. stale_s: no pressure data for longer sets every flow to 0. p_max_pa: chamber pressure above it sets every flow to 0 (latched). pumped_below_pa: the main chamber counts as pumped below it. pump_path: valves that must all be open to pump the main chamber while gas flows. Gauges: chamber_frg, chamber_img, chamber_hfig, loadlock_frg, gun, column.
